Disseminations of Reports / "Nuklir" social network analysis at X/Twitter

"Nuklir" social network analysis at X/Twitter

Published 19 October 2026

Ishak Martins, Adisty Ramadhani

Lokanetra Information Observatory

Download PDFCite this dataset

Introduction

This report is a test drive of our software modules and practice for our data visualisation styles.

Findings

  • The dataset holds 2,937 tweets from 1,973 unique accounts, with 464,351 likes, 121,951 retweets, 15,395 comments and 601,697 engagement.
  • Replies total 1,746, original tweets 751 and quotes 440.
  • The word counts start with nuklir (3,574), iran (1,671), senjata (1,175), punya (960), negara (783) and prabowo (572).
  • Stance labels on 294 tweets show H1 (support for the Prabowo statement that Iran has or may have nuclear weapons) at 1.4% Agrees, 23.1% Disagrees and 75.5% Not related; H2 (Indonesia has a right or should speak in public on the nuclear status of other states such as Iran) at 0.3% Agrees, 4.8% Disagrees and 94.9% Not related; H3 (the Prabowo statement raises the risk of a nuclear arms race in the Middle East) at 0.3% Agrees, 0.0% Disagrees and 99.7% Not related.
  • Evidence tiers place 1,547 accounts in T0 (No signals), 327 in T1 (Burst participation only), 99 in T2 (Metadata-suspicious) and 0 in T3 (Coordinated); the dataset has 27 burst hours.
  • Emotion labels cover 2,937 tweets, with Anger at 42.2%, Disgust at 30.7%, Fear at 21.2%, Anticipation at 13.6%, Surprise at 13.0%, Joy at 11.5%, Sadness at 5.4% and Trust at 4.2%; a tweet can carry several labels.

Remarks

We have no remarks for this report.

Amplification

Source: Kestrel Parts D and E. 1,973 accounts. Tiers describe evidence found in this dataset. They are not a claim that an account is automated, paid or coordinated.

Evidence tiers

Accounts per evidence tier

T0No signals
1,547 accounts, 78%

Nothing in this corpus separates this account from ordinary participation.

T1Burst participation only
327 accounts, 17%

The account posted inside an amplification burst and nothing else fired. Never filtered: posting during a spike is what an interested human does too.

T2Metadata-suspicious
99 accounts, 5%

At least two independent evidence families fired (burst-exclusive posting, creation inside a creation burst, extreme profile metadata, high near-duplicate/self-repetition).

T3Coordinated
0 accounts, 0%

This account sits in a cluster that stayed outside the permutation null after FDR correction. The strongest evidence tier, and the only one the de-amplified corpus removes by default.
